text:
Rina (CS): Heads-up — Cerebra Systems renewal due next week. They want to shorten from 12mo -> 10mo, add 12 seats, and require split invoices for their EU ops and US subsidiary. Also asking if the onboarding credit can be applied pro rata or pushed to the first invoice. Any concerns?
Abe (Sales): Quick Q: will we hold the same unit price for 10mo? Customer expects price parity. Procurement also wants separate POs per entity.
Rina (CS): They explicitly requested price parity. Procurement says two invoices are mandatory for chargebacks. Might slow signing.
Nina (Legal): Split invoices are fine. We need exact legal names, VAT IDs, and PO text. I'll prepare a short amendment: term change, seat delta, and credit allocation.
Jorge (Billing): We can issue two invoices. Need vendor codes, billing emails, and VAT details for EU. Our billing system applies credits at account level but we can allocate a one-time credit pro rata if documented.
Lina (PM): Onboarding request: they want "kickstart" within 21 days and a go-live checklist. We can commit to 2 sessions + checklist.
Abe (Sales): I'll push to keep unit price flat. If finance pushes back, we flag discount approval.
InvoiceBot: Draft invoice snapshot:
```
INVOICE DRAFT
Cerebra EU (Entity A) -  8,640 EUR - 8 seats (10mo prorated)
Cerebra US (Entity B) - $3,360 USD - 4 seats (10mo prorated)
Onboarding credit: 1,000 split pro rata (pending amendment)
```
Rina (CS): Timing note: Jorge needs POs and vendor codes by Wed COB to hit billing cycle. Procurement warned cross-entity approvals may add 3 business days.
Nina (Legal): I'll include "onboarding credit to be allocated pro rata across split invoices unless otherwise instructed in writing" in the amendment and route via DocuSign.
Jorge (Billing): After signed amendment, I can generate both invoices and apply the pro rata credit. Please confirm vendor codes and PO numbers ASAP.
Abe (Sales): I'll request POs, VAT IDs, and billing contacts now.
Lina (PM): Holding 2x 90-min kickstart slots in week 1 post-sign. Will draft go-live checklist and share.
Rina (CS): Action items:
- Abe: collect PO numbers, legal names, VAT IDs (owner)
- Nina: draft amendment + DocuSign
- Jorge: prepare split-invoice templates and credit allocation flow
- Lina: prep onboarding checklist and tentative session times
I'll update the renewal tracker and ping if we miss Wed COB. Thanks all :party_parrot:
